instructions.value: On threat trials, participants were told they might receive a painful electric stimulus at any time during the 17.7-second trial; on no-threat trials, they were told they would not be stimulated. On reappraisal trials, they were instructed to adopt a detached observer position, imagine a cloud far away on the horizon, and mentally rehearse the statement “The cloud is far out on the horizon. I observe it from a distance.” On no-reappraisal trials, they were instructed to attend to the situation and their emotional reactions without trying to change them. Participants kept their eyes closed during trials.

Reappraisal material consisted of a mental image of a cloud and a detached-observer self-statement.

model_settings.value: Random-effects group analysis using SPM8 flexible factorial modeling with correction for nonsphericity due to dependence among conditions. The group design contained 25 regressors: four condition regressors and 21 subject constants. Subject-level regressors modeled tonic and linearly increasing trial responses; linearly decreasing responses were assessed by multiplying increasing-response parameter estimates by −1. Temporal autocorrelation was modeled using first-order autoregression.
